## [1.0.1](https://github.com/SeveriT/morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1) (2026-11-07)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Offer the same color presets, including yellow, in every color option ([dcdbc6e](https://github.com/SeveriT/morphe-patches/commit/dcdbc6e1d06d2e87c543a1ca77eb7bc6cd4aa474))

patches.name: Custom accent color
patches.description: Replaces Strava's orange brand color and its lighter and darker shades with a color of your choice, in both light and dark theme.

options.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) that replaces Strava's orange. Lighter and darker shades are generated from it.
Also recolor orange in vector icons, badges and map pins, including the Strava logo shown inside the app.

patches.name: Custom map route color
patches.description: Changes the color of route and activity lines drawn on maps, independently of the accent color.

options.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) of route and activity lines on maps. Lighter secondary lines are generated from it.
Hex color (#RRGGBB) of the live line while recording. Leave empty to keep Strava's blue.
